prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity mobile trip detail product page for Coliclic, a peer-to-peer parcel transport app, opened after tapping a search result.
Create ONE polished portrait mobile UI mockup, 390x844 logical viewport displayed large, front-facing flat screenshot, no tilted phone or 3D hardware, no surrounding presentation text. French interface. Respect existing visual system: #023047 deep blue, #FB8500 orange primary action, #219ebc secondary, #FAFAFA background, white surfaces, #E8E8EC dividers. Poppins/DM Sans style typography, readable large text, accessible spacing. This is a parcel transport service, not passenger seats. Use realistic fictional sample data consistently: Paris to Abidjan, departure 12 novembre 2026 at 10:30, arrival 12 novembre at 17:00, traveler Aminata K., rating 4,9 and 24 avis, 15 kg available, 12 €/kg. Reservation requires traveler approval. Use wording "Sur accord du voyageur". Header has back chevron and "Détail du trajet", small Coliclic wordmark. Always show both endpoint dates/times, traveler, rating, available kg and price, plus a fixed bottom booking bar above safe area with very prominent orange button exact text "Réserver". Avoid claiming payment protection, insurance, verified identity, unimplemented guaranteed services, a ticket purchase or passenger seats. No fake map controls, no watermark. Keep layout plausibly implementable and do not add dense tiny text.
Direction 1 — Essential summary. White airy card-based interface closest to existing app. Large title "Paris → Abidjan". Below it a prominent deep-blue itinerary card with two vertical timeline endpoints, date and times in white. Next a white traveler row with a small realistic portrait, name and orange rating. Two metric tiles "15 kg disponibles" and "12 €/kg". A concise section "À savoir" with "Sur accord du voyageur" and "Remise à convenir". Fixed white bottom bar: price left and large orange "Réserver" right. Elegant restrained hierarchy, highly legible.
